fact: Chapter 9 is titled 'Obstacle Of Mental Excellence', and it opens 'Every great door commands the attention of adversaries'
1 Corinthians 16:9 is quoted: 'For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries'
The enemy knows your mind is the gateway to your life and the role it plays in moulding your destiny, so he constantly organizes obstacles on the way
The devil is called a mind-blocker: he organizes programmes to blind your mind, because when your mind is blinded your destiny is blocked and your future becomes uncertain

2 Corinthians 4:3-4 is quoted: 'In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them'
Satan is interested in the state of your mind, because if he can blind it then he can get at anything else in your life
With drug addicts the devil plays on their minds by deceiving them to try out pleasures, and it is in the process of trying out pleasures that they multiply pressures for themselves
The devil uses tricks and gimmicks to get his results because he has lost all his power
Genesis 3:1 is cited: 'Now the serpent was more subtle than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made'
The devil is very crafty and you cannot catch him easily, except you are spiritually smart
The SIX obstacles to mental excellence are sin, accepting the status quo, the trap of past failures, the pride of past achievements, comparison, and the fear of curses and enchantments
Sin is the first obstacle, and Adam before the fall was a symbol of supernatural mental excellence who knew almost everything
Adam single-handedly named all the animals that God created, but the devil got him through sin
Ezekiel 18:4 is quoted: 'The soul that sinneth, it shall die'
When you habitually live in sin you are destroying your mental capacity
Dr. T. L. Osborn said 'Every time you sin, something dies in you', and the author believes one of the things that die is their heritage of mental excellence
After he had sinned, Adam could not think of any other way of covering himself except with leaves, because he had stepped out of mental excellence
Sin corrupts mentality, and no crooked man or woman is a worthy candidate for mental excellence, having sold off his birthright to stealing, adultery, crookedness or perverseness
It takes the fear of God to walk in mental excellence, and the fear of God grants you unlimited access into the deep things of God
If you want to be profound mentally you must shun sin and embrace integrity as a way of life

One of the blockades the enemy establishes is to give you a good taste for perverseness, crookedness and sin, blocking the mind until the brain cells are fully paralysed and the man starts doing silly and crazy things
Hebrews 6:12 advises that we should be followers of those who through faith and patience obtained the promise

Joseph did not only resist the temptation of escaping from slavery in Potiphar's house, though he was grown enough to know the way back home and never attempted it, he also did not play around with his master's substance
Every man of integrity naturally enjoys mental dignity, and Joseph was an honest man, a man of truth and verity, with nothing crafty in his life
If you want anything from God you have to come on His terms, not yours
Sin is called Satan's number one trap: by enhancing and promoting your taste for sin he drags you into the net of mental failure
Accepting the status quo is the second obstacle: the enemy gets them thinking 'This is where I belong. God has tried. This is just okay'
The moment you stop pushing, you start crashing
Do not ever get to the point where, if you do not make it, you conclude that God has not planned for you to make it; such an attitude is accepting the status quo, and it paralyses mental excellence
Proverbs 4:18 says the path of the just is like a shining light that shines more and more unto the perfect day
Deuteronomy 28:1 is paraphrased as God saying if you come on line with Me and do what I tell you to do, I will set you up on high above all nations of the earth
By making you accept the status quo the devil stops you from seeing any better future than the one you have now, and only those who see what lies ahead take steps toward it
When life is void of progress it becomes a burden, and nothing motivates the brain to work like seeing something ahead of you
When your brain is no longer working towards anything it becomes a weight on your body
Kenneth Hagin wrote a book on healing in 1996 that was more powerful than the one he wrote in 1960, thirty-six years before
The trap of past failures is the third obstacle, being the trap of mental torture generated by dwelling on the irreparable past
Satan connects you so much to the past that you cannot see anything ahead anymore: you think about your car that had an accident and was a write-off, and about the exam you wrote and failed
Isaiah 43:18 says 'Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old'
The past is dead and can no longer be corrected, so leave it in the grave and take the next step forward
Isaiah 43:19 says 'Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert'
If you will not forget the former things you are not likely to know the new things that God is about to do, and only those who are smart enough to bury their past enjoy a great future

Philippians 3:13-14 is quoted: 'This one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus'
If you do not let the past be past you are likely to pass away with it, so bury the past otherwise you will be buried along with it
Proverbs 24:16 says 'For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again'
Micah 7:8 is quoted: 'Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me'
In wrestling tournaments there is no world champion who was not once on the floor, and you will never find a general who has no scars, yet at the end he has two or three stars on his shoulder
The instruction is to stop whining on the floor and not wait for the final count, or you will be out of the tournament
At times blood drips down the nostrils of the champion at the end of the contest, and in spite of this his arms are still raised in victory as the winner
If there is anything to remember in the past let it be your great successes, accomplishments and great results: your testimonies, not your trials, are what should be kept in remembrance
Anything negative is not worthy of a place in your memory bank because it paralyzes mentality

The author knows an educated elderly person who never travels in aeroplanes just because he has seen one or two planes crash, and who would rather travel by road on long-distance journeys, so even if something good waited for him in Canada he would not go
The author told that man there are more car accidents than plane crashes, and that every day on our roads there is an accident
The pride of past achievements is named as the FOURTH obstacle to mental excellence
The pride of past achievements has a way of paralysing your drive and mentality, and in turn stunting your growth
What appears standard today very soon becomes sub-standard tomorrow
The idiomatic expression cited is that one should not rest on one's oars, meaning do not dwell too much on past achievements
Micah 2:10 is quoted: 'Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction'
The rich fool prided himself that he had laid up enough to eat and drink till his time on earth was over, but God proved that such a person has no reason to be alive anymore
The author said in his book 'Towards Excellence in Life & Ministry' that when your assignment becomes a task, all your senses will come alive and all your brain cells will take on new life
To remain mentally awake you have to keep moving towards a well-defined target
Many have pitched their tents mentally, and no wonder they are not moving forward any more

There are people with whom the author started off in ministry who today are still struggling to pay the rent of the facilities they use for service, still renting chairs and negotiating with landlords, because they got to a point and felt this is the place to pitch our tent
There is a time to rent and another time to be a house owner, and if you do not know the difference between the two timings you will lose relevance
If you pitch your tent too early you will lose relevance in no time
Comparison is the fifth obstacle, and 2 Corinthians 10:12 is its text, that they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise
The obstacle is specifically comparing yourself with others, especially the less-privileged
The devil keeps reminding you of how many of your age mates are farmers in the village and how many have died, telling you to thank God you are still alive and that that is enough
The privileges around you are pointers to the mission that God has ordained you to accomplish, and much is expected from whom much is given
You have to believe in the principle of identity, because you are here on a mission

There are TWO sides to the trap of comparison: comparing yourself with those more privileged, asking 'Can I ever get there?', and comparing yourself with those less privileged, saying 'I think I have tried'
Luke 12:48 is cited: unto whom much is given, much is required, and whether negative or positive you are answerable only to God
Jesus spoke to Peter about his future and Peter asked 'What about this man?', and Jesus said if it is my wish that the man tarries till I come, what is your business, cited as John 21:20-22
1 Thessalonians 4:11 is cited again: 'Study to be quiet and do your own business', so stop wondering about what the other man will do
The fear of curses and enchantments is the sixth obstacle, and Galatians 3:13-14 is its text: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us
If you have been redeemed by the blood of Jesus Christ, curses and enchantments have lost their hold on your life, and you are now connected to the blessing channel of Abraham
Genesis 12:3 is quoted: 'And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed'
That means you cannot be cursed, molested, enchanted or bewitched
Many have stopped thinking because they have been made to believe there is a curse working against them, saying 'No matter how much I try, from the fourth generation till now, it has been the same'

Such a man has whatever he hears in church bounce back with no real impact, and he despises whatever he reads in books; he has fasted forty days over the matter but has not given it a thought for one second
The two questions asked are 'Who is stronger, the witch or God?' and 'Which is more valid, the word of a witch or the Word of God?'
Driving on the highway the author overtook a woman he perceived must be one of the terrible witches in that city, and she met him at a filling station where he had stopped to refuel
With gleaming eyes she snapped 'You overtook me like that? There's no way you will get to where you're going', and he quickly replied 'As soon as I get there, you will hear'
The word used to describe fear is paranoid, because it has a paralysing effect on its victim
People who live in fear hardly think well, because fear paralyzes mentality
